headline: Sensex plunges 1,484 points and Nifty dives below 25,350 dragged down by banking and metal stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Heavy sell-off in banking and metal stocks dragged down benchmark indices.
India VIX jumped nearly 8%, reflecting heightened volatility and investor angst.
Rupee snapped a 5-day rally, tumbling 30 paise to 92.92 against the U.S. dollar.
Weak global cues and heavy intraday profit-taking erased early opening gains.
whatHappening: Sensex plunged 1,484 points while Nifty 50 closed below the 25,350 mark at 25,349.65.
Investors lost over Rs 5 to 6 lakh crore in market capitalization during the crash.
Nifty Bank dropped significantly as bank shares faced widespread drubbing.
Tata Steel emerged as one of the top losers during the market sell-off.
summary: Indian benchmark indices suffered a massive crash on Monday with Sensex tumbling nearly 1,500 points and Nifty sliding below 25,350. The sharp decline wiped out over Rs 5 lakh crore of investor wealth, dragged by heavy losses in banking and metal sectors. The rupee also broke its 5-day winning streak, adding to overall market weakness.
